audience: teams who turn audio and video recordings into text with Speechmatics

useCases.title: Transcribe a recording from a link
useCases.text: The AI submits a public audio or video URL for transcription, optionally with speaker labels, translation and a summary. It then checks the job until it is done.

useCases.title: Get the transcript of a finished job
useCases.text: The AI fetches a done job's transcript as plain text, subtitles (SRT) or structured JSON with words, timings and speakers.

useCases.title: Check which jobs are done
useCases.text: The AI lists your recent transcription jobs, newest first, with status, name and duration. You see what finished and what is still running.

useCases.title: Find out why a job was rejected
useCases.text: The AI reads the job status and the plain-text processing log of a job. You get the reason it failed.

useCases.title: Check the transcription minutes used
useCases.text: The AI reads usage statistics, in transcription minutes, over a date range you choose.

useCases.title: Delete a job and its transcript
useCases.text: The AI permanently deletes a job and its transcript, and can force the delete while a job is still running.
